snippet.title: HMUR Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Fight through a collapsing high-tech Soviet city in this fast-paced first-person shooter. Brutal action, retro-inspired gunplay, and an alternate-history setting drive the chaos.

Developed by FoxusSexus and published by Valkyrie Initiative.
